about: The V1 donor stand-ins in src/stubs.ts that carry names or text. `weaponSlots`: the loot slot names that hold a weapon (V1 core/loot.ts WEAPON_SLOTS): the opponent's worn kit (kitWorn) leaves them out, the weapon comes from the fight row. `lessonFell` / `lessonNext`: V1 lessons.ts LESSON_FELL and LESSON_NEXT, kept because the donor feel layer imports them (V3 has no lesson fight). Presentation only.
lessonFell: You fell. That was the lesson.
